patternHint: Glob pattern: * matches within a segment, ** across slashes.
branch.title: Branch protection
branch.hint: Rules apply to every branch whose name matches the pattern.
branch.f.requireCodeOwnerReviews.hint: A code owner of every changed path must approve.
branch.f.dismissStaleReviews.hint: A new push removes the approvals given before it.
branch.f.strictStatusChecks: Require an up to date branch
branch.f.strictStatusChecks.hint: The branch must contain the latest base commit before merging.
branch.f.requireSignedCommits.hint: Every new commit needs a verified GPG or SSH signature.
branch.f.allowForcePushes.hint: Lets people with push access rewrite history.
branch.f.allowDeletions.hint: Lets people with push access delete the branch.
branch.f.restrictPushes.hint: Only the users and teams listed below can push.
tag.title: Tag rules
tag.hint: Control who can create, move and delete tags that match a pattern.
tag.levelsHint: Choose who may do each action. Nobody blocks it for everyone not listed.
